chat.placeholder: Ask the agent to browse, search or fill in a form…

toolbar.label: Browser controls
toolbar.addressPlaceholder: Search or type a web address
toolbar.followOnHint: Following the agent: the view jumps to whichever tab an agent is working in
toolbar.followOffHint: Not following: the view stays on the tab you chose
toolbar.adblockOnHint: Ad blocker is on. Click to turn it off.
toolbar.adblockOffHint: Ad blocker is off. Click to turn it on.
toolbar.openExternalHint: Opens this page in your usual browser. Logins from the Mini Browser don't carry over.
toolbar.stopAgentHint: Stop the agent that is using this tab

tabs.label: Browser tabs
tabs.busy: An agent is working in this tab
tabs.userControl: Agent paused — you have control of this tab
tabs.closeBusyMessage: {{owner}} is working in this tab. Closing it stops what the agent is doing here.

live.label: Live web page
live.keyboardHint: Your clicks and typing go to the web page. Press Escape twice to return to the address bar.
live.takeControlHint: Pause the agent on this tab and use it yourself — for example to solve a CAPTCHA or enter a sign-in code. Hand it back when you're done.
live.inControl: You're in control — the agent is paused on this tab
live.handBackHint: Let the agent continue on this tab
live.reconnectingHint: The live view resumes as soon as CraftBot is back.
live.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the selection to your clipboard
live.pasteTruncated: The text was too long, so only the first {{max}} characters were pasted.

status.installingHint: Downloading Chromium. This can take a few minutes.
status.errorTitle: The browser ran into a problem
status.stoppedTitle: Browse the web together with your agent
status.stoppedBody: A real browser you share with your agents. Watch them work live, or step in whenever you like.

examples.compare: Compare prices for noise-cancelling headphones on three shopping sites
examples.news: Open a news site and summarize today's top stories
examples.research: Look up the weather forecast for Tokyo this weekend

status.featureWatchBody: Each agent works in its own tab. Follow along as it clicks, types and scrolls.
status.featureControlBody: Click or type in the page and the agent pauses on that tab until you hand it back.
status.featureLoginsBody: Save a password once and agents can sign in for you, without ever seeing it.
status.profileInUseHint: Close the other CraftBot window that is using the Mini Browser, then try again.

events.downloadDangerous: This type of file can run programs on your computer. Open it only if you trust where it came from.
events.popup: The page opened a new tab
events.dialogGeneric: The page showed a dialog, which was answered automatically
events.blockedGeneric: The Mini Browser blocked a page it doesn't open
events.crash: A tab crashed. It reloads the next time it's used.
events.problem: The Mini Browser ran into a problem

confirm.shutdownMessage: An agent is still browsing. Closing the browser closes every tab, but an agent that is still working may open it again. To stop an agent, press Stop in its chat.

passwords.title: Saved passwords
passwords.intro: Agents use these to sign in for you. Passwords are encrypted on this computer and are never shown to the agent or sent back to this page.
passwords.protectionFile: Encrypted with a key stored on this computer
passwords.empty: No saved logins yet. Add one below, then ask the agent to sign you in.
passwords.emptyUnreadable: Saved logins can't be shown until the vault can be read again.
passwords.deleteMessage: Delete the saved login for {{username}} on {{site}}? Agents won't be able to sign in there with it anymore.
passwords.siteHint: Used only on this exact site (with or without “www.”), over a secure (HTTPS) connection. A sign-in page on a different subdomain needs its own entry.
passwords.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the current password
passwords.label: Label (optional)
passwords.willReplace: You already have a login for {{username}} on {{site}}. Saving replaces its password.
passwords.notConnected: Not connected to CraftBot. Try again in a moment.
passwords.timeout: CraftBot didn't answer in time. Check the list and try again.
passwords.unreadableTitle: The password vault can't be read
passwords.unavailableTitle: Saved logins can't be loaded right now
passwords.unavailableBody: The password vault is busy or unavailable at the moment — for example, another program is using its file. Your saved logins aren't lost. Try again in a moment.
passwords.unreadableBody: Your saved logins are still there, but they can't be decrypted on this computer (for example, because the encryption key changed). Nothing was overwritten. Reset the vault to start over; the unreadable file is kept as a backup.
passwords.resetMessage: This starts a new, empty vault. The unreadable vault file is kept as a backup.

MINI_BROWSER_PLAYWRIGHT_MISSING.title: Browser engine not installed
MINI_BROWSER_PLAYWRIGHT_MISSING.message: The Mini Browser needs its browser engine (Playwright), which isn't installed yet.

MINI_BROWSER_CHROMIUM_MISSING.title: Browser not installed
MINI_BROWSER_CHROMIUM_MISSING.message: The Mini Browser's Chromium isn't installed yet. You can install it here; it's a one-time download.

MINI_BROWSER_PROFILE_IN_USE.title: Browser profile in use
MINI_BROWSER_PROFILE_IN_USE.message: Another CraftBot window is already using the Mini Browser's profile.

MINI_BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED.title: The browser didn't start
MINI_BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED.message: Chromium couldn't be launched. Try again; if it keeps failing, reinstall the browser.

MINI_BROWSER_NOT_RUNNING.title: Browser not running
MINI_BROWSER_NOT_RUNNING.message: The Mini Browser isn't running. Start it to continue.

MINI_BROWSER_CLOSED.title: Browser closed
MINI_BROWSER_CLOSED.message: The Mini Browser was closed before this could finish.

MINI_BROWSER_NAVIGATION_FAILED.title: Page didn't load
MINI_BROWSER_NAVIGATION_FAILED.message: The page couldn't be opened. Check the address and your internet connection.

MINI_BROWSER_BLOCKED_URL.title: Address blocked
MINI_BROWSER_BLOCKED_URL.message: The Mini Browser doesn't open this kind of address.

MINI_BROWSER_PAGE_UNRESPONSIVE.title: Page not responding
MINI_BROWSER_PAGE_UNRESPONSIVE.message: The page didn't respond in time. Try again, reload it, or open another tab.

MINI_BROWSER_TAB_NOT_FOUND.title: Tab not found
MINI_BROWSER_TAB_NOT_FOUND.message: That tab is no longer open.

MINI_BROWSER_TAB_CLOSED.title: Tab closed
MINI_BROWSER_TAB_CLOSED.message: The tab was closed before this could finish.

MINI_BROWSER_TOO_MANY_TABS.title: Too many tabs
MINI_BROWSER_TOO_MANY_TABS.message: Too many tabs are open. Close a tab, then try again.

MINI_BROWSER_TIMEOUT.title: Timed out
MINI_BROWSER_TIMEOUT.message: That took too long. Try again.

MINI_BROWSER_VAULT_UNREADABLE.title: Password vault unreadable
MINI_BROWSER_VAULT_UNREADABLE.message: The saved-password vault can't be decrypted on this computer. Nothing was overwritten; you can reset it under Saved passwords.

MINI_BROWSER_VAULT_INVALID.title: Check the login details
MINI_BROWSER_VAULT_INVALID.message: Some of the login details aren't valid.

MINI_BROWSER_VAULT_IO.title: Couldn't save the vault
MINI_BROWSER_VAULT_IO.message: The password vault couldn't be written to disk.

MINI_BROWSER_INSTALL_FAILED.title: Install failed
MINI_BROWSER_INSTALL_FAILED.message: Installing Chromium didn't finish. Check your internet connection and try again.

MINI_BROWSER_INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong
MINI_BROWSER_INTERNAL.message: The Mini Browser ran into an unexpected problem.
